notes.title: New Patch Arrives!
notes.content:
Greetings, Martians!

As many of you know, MARS 2120 has been our most ambitious project, and it’s been incredible to see the love and support across all platforms! We’ve been listening closely to all your feedback and suggestions, and today, we’re excited to bring you a major update to make your experience on the Red Planet even better.

Here’s what’s new:

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]We implemented general improvements to fix a variety of identified bugs.

[b]Balance Adjustments: [/b]Enemy and boss difficulty has been fine-tuned to provide a fairer and more challenging experience.

[b]Localization Enhancements:[/b] We reviewed translations across all languages for better cultural adaptation and accuracy.

[b]Map Adjustments: [/b]General updates were made to improve map navigation and visibility.
Collision Fixes: We refined object collisions across environments to improve interaction and enhance realism.

[b]Experience Orb Colors: [/b]Updated the colors of experience orbs for improved distinction and visibility during gameplay.

[b]Door and Secret Wall Interaction:[/b] The character can now open doors and break secret walls by striking them, adding more versatility to exploration.

[b]New Fire Interactions: [/b]You can now burn vines using a wider variety of fire attacks, adding more tactical options to gameplay.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Delete Saves: It’s now possible to delete individual saves from each slot.
[*] Tutorial Screen: A new tutorial screen is available in both the pause and main menus, making helpful game information easily accessible.
[*] Audiolog Screen: We’ve added an audiolog screen in the pause and main menus, allowing you to revisit recordings found in the game.
[/list]

We’re grateful to everyone who has joined us on this journey so far. We’ll keep working to ensure MARS 2120 is an unforgettable experience!

See you on Mars! 🚀

notes.title: MARS 2120 - First Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re thrilled to announce the release of the first Update for [b]MARS 2120[/b]! 

Since our launch, the feedback from our players has been very positive. We are grateful for your support and excitement for future updates. With this first patch, we’ve focused on improving your overall gaming experience with some quality of life (QoL) changes and bug fixes.

[h2][b]Quality of Life (QoL) Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Experience Warnings: We've added a warning if you lack sufficient experience to purchase an upgrade. Additionally, you’ll now receive a notification when trying to buy an upgrade with the “No Upgrades” option enabled.
[*] Unsaved Settings Warning: If you attempt to leave the settings menu without saving your changes, you'll now be prompted with a warning to prevent any accidental loss of customization.
[*] Game Space Saved Notification: To keep you informed, a new notification has been added to indicate when your game space is successfully saved.
[*] Experience Notification for Yellow Orbs: Players will now receive a notification when collecting yellow orbs, giving clearer feedback on experience gains.
[*] Final Cutscene Subtitles: Subtitles have been added to the final cutscene, ensuring everyone can fully enjoy the story.
[*] Upgrade Availability Adjustments: We’ve made adjustments to clarify when upgrades are available or unavailable for purchase, reducing any potential confusion.
[*] Checkpoint Indicator Adjustment: The checkpoint indicators have been tweaked for better clarity and visibility during gameplay.
[*] Audio Adjustments: We've made several audio tweaks across the game to enhance immersion and overall sound quality.
[*] Text Localization Fixes: Various text localization issues have been resolved, ensuring a more consistent experience for players across different languages.
[/list]
We’re committed to continuously improving MARS 2120 and are excited to bring you even more updates in the future. 

Thank you for being part of our community, and we can’t wait to see how you explore MARS.

notes.title: MARS 2120 IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
Attention all explorers! 🌌 MARS 2120 has officially launched and is ready for you to dive into RIGHT NOW!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937515/ca3ec2e837fc6964dbe24ccaa29f74066354049f.jpg[/img]
It feels great to share this with you. We've worked hard for years on this project, and it's finally here. Our team has put their hearts into it, and we're proud of what we've done.

[h2]PLATFORMS AND BUGS/FEEDBACK[/h2]

The game is available on Steam, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch. 

We’re eager to hear your thoughts and experiences! [url=discord.gg/qubyte]Join our community on Discord [/url]to share feedback and discuss all things MARS 2120. Your input is invaluable as we continue to refine the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937515/b4b0b872d9af1d5452041a82a53d13000d3689fa.jpg[/img]
[h2] PLAYABLE ON STEAM DECK[/h2]
The game runs really well on Deck, and the only small issue is that some text is a bit small. We'll fix it as soon as we can, but in the meantime, don't be afraid to load it up on the Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937515/fd6a9d3be7542ba45712987c37cba9d2f70f59d2.png[/img]

[h2]DISCOVER THE SECRETS OF MARS[/h2]

Explore a post-colonization Mars, where danger and mystery await around every corner. Here are a few tips to get you started:

[b]Harness Your Abilities![/b]
[i]Use your elemental powers to navigate through different biomes. You'll see that in some areas you'll only be able to pass with certain skills. [/i]

[b]Explore everything![/b]
[i]There are hidden areas and secrets all over Mars. Take your time to explore and you’ll be rewarded with powerful upgrades and insights.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38937515/43f1e87a0a30ba9808724e10782cb7e47d6cc095.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy the adventure as much as we enjoyed creating it. 

[b]Your journey through MARS 2120 awaits! 🚀[/b]

First of all, this is the last update we'll be posting on Steam during the early access period. From now on, [b]MARS 2120[/b] will be officially released.

We are in the final stages of adjustments, and with that in mind, we would like to inform you that the game's price will be adjusted in preparation for the official launch.

[b]So, keep an eye out![/b] Starting from June 29th, the price of MARS 2120 will change. Until then, you can still purchase the game at the current price.

Thank you for your support, and we'll see you soon!

notes.title: Early Access AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
Mars 2120 is a brand-new sci-fi metroidvania, with a rich world, strong female lead and a mix of ranged and melee combat.

It is currently in Beta, meaning all major gameplay elements are implemented and filled with amazing content!

The Early access is a fantastic way for us to put our game to test in the hands of avid gamers in the community. With the help of experienced gamers, and newcomers alike, we expect to turn MARS 2120 into something really special.

We have been actively working on the development of the game since 2019, but none of that matters if the game is not good enough for all of you!

As we move forward with the performance fine tuning, graphical adjustments and overall improvements over the course of the next few months leading the final release of the game, we found an opportunity to work closer with the community by collecting your feedback, suggestions and ideas, and use this time to onboard new features and improvements to build an even better game.

notes.title: Main Theme of Project Colonies: MARS 2120 is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-NuIRygUKlA;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello guys!

The Main theme is now part of the 2.5D side-scrolling action-adventure, of the Metroidvania subgenre, in which players take control of Lt. Anna “Charlotte” Right, a member of an enhanced elite group of Space Marines, sent on a Mission to the first Human Colony on Mars after a distress signal has been received on Earth.

In addition to the epic graphics, the unique soundtrack set you in a world full of immersion that QUByte and Rafael have been working for a while to be just as memorable as the game itself.

“The process of creating the tracks is present from the first moments of creation of the game, since the conversations are intimately with the experience and the atmosphere that we created for the game. So, from the beginning, there was a synergy between the track creation and game design teams, and we hope the overall experience reflects that”, said the [b]producer, Bruno Carvalho.[/b]

[h3]Project Colonies: MARS 2120 is currently set to release this year on Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series S/X, Xbox One, PS4, PS5, Steam and Epic Store.[/h3]
